source_inspection.scope: Three once-only fresh generations. Examined complete Poppler pages for Transformer p8, GPT-2 p4, GPT-3 p8 and p43, source-pinned native GPT-1 training text and published claims. These source PDFs match prior fully inspected originals. Review is not independent expert review, nine-case candidate acceptance, frontend acceptance or all-corpus acceptance. Raw free-form summaries are preserved but the product publishes checked claims, not the unchecked summary.

bleu-improvement.reason: Published score and previous-best including ensembles select the same EN-DE BLEU column: 28.4 versus ConvS2S Ensemble 26.36; published deterministic 2.04 subtraction is explicitly derived. No published contradictory refusal remains. A generated derived claim was filtered, but its validated table proof is published with original table anchor.

gpt-parameter-evolution.reason: Published largest GPT-2 1542M and qualified original-GPT 117M baseline inference match GPT-2 p4 table/equivalence; GPT-3 1750 yi/175B main variant and eight sizes match p8. Scientific claims are supported, but live runtime wrongly marks GPT-3 incomplete because it misses a parenthetical equivalent count before the parameter label. Preserve the live failure; later grammar repair is only offline confirmation.

context-evolution.reason: Published GPT-2 1024 and GPT-3 full-window 2048 match architectural configuration and full-window descriptions. Published GPT-1 512 is explicitly labelled as an inference from the GPT-2 named OpenAI-GPT architectural baseline and 512-to-1024 comparison, not from GPT-1 training-sequence length. The source limitation is separate from this inference. The unchecked raw summary contradicts this inference but is not the published answer; both raw and checked outputs remain preserved.
